subject: Renewal negotiation — FirmWave: pricing concession + SLA add-on authorization
messages:
From: Eliza Morgan <eliza@firmwave.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@firmwave.com
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Upcoming renewal — need options for pricing + SLA

Hi Aditya,

Our renewal for the Redwood platform is up on 2026-11-01. Over the past quarter we've had two production-impacting incidents that increased our internal support costs and caused missed SLAs on our end. We're a long-time customer and want to renew, but we need better financial and SLA protections to justify the spend to our CFO.

Specifically we are asking for:
- A one-time operational credit to offset incident costs (ballpark $40k)
- A 12-month price reduction to compensate for reliability issues
- An SLA add-on for priority engineering response for critical incidents

Can you share what flexibility Redwood has here? If you can provide a revised offer this week, I can present it to procurement and legal. I attached our renewal request and a short note from finance.

Thanks,
Eliza Morgan
Head of IT Procurement
FirmWave Inc.

Attachments: FW-Renewal-Req-20260929.pdf (pdf)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Eliza Morgan <eliza@firmwave.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 12:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal — need options for pricing + SLA

Eliza — thanks for the clear note and for calling this out. I’m sorry you experienced the incidents; we take reliability seriously and want to keep FirmWave on a path to success.

Short version: we can craft a renewal that combines a one-time operational credit, a temporary price concession, and an SLA upgrade for critical response. I’m looping in my manager (Marissa) to request approval for non-standard concessions.

Proposed structure (internal ask to leadership):
- One-time credit: $40,000 applied at renewal
- Discount: 20% on list for the next 12 months (to demonstrate good faith)
- SLA add-on: guaranteed 2-hour P1 response + quarterly reliability review for 12 months
- Term: standard 12 months or optional 18 months if we increase the credit to $60,000 (customer preference)

Attachments: RW-RevOffer-v3.pdf (draft offer).

Marissa — could you review for exec approval? This will reduce year-1 ARR and increase short-term churn risk mitigation spend.

Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: FirmWave renewal — request for approval (business case)

Team — escalating for authorization. Context and ask below.

Customer: FirmWave Inc. (Deal FW-2026-042)
ARR at risk: $2.1M ARR (renewal for their enterprise bundle)
Renewal date: 2026-11-01
Churn risk: High — customer signaled they may move to competitor if terms not improved

Aditya's proposed concessions (requested):
- $40k one-time credit (applied on renewal invoice)
- 20% discount for 12 months (material margin hit in Y1)
- SLA add-on: 2-hour P1 response, quarterly reliability reviews
- Optional: extend term to 18 months with a $60k credit (customer preferred but asks for flexibility)

Why we should approve:
- Strategic customer: referenceable in healthcare analytics vertical; churn would be >$2M ARR loss and risk to regional renewals pipeline
- Cost of losing the account (revenue + strategic) > cost of concession
- We can instrument quality regressions with a dedicated quarterly review and a small SLO SLA surcharge if needed

Risks:
- Sets precedent for credits if we give full 20% and $40k.
- Margin impact on Q4/Q1 booking and potential impact to quota/comp.

Request: Vivek/Naomi, please approve or counter with limits we can offer (discount cap, credit cap, term requirement). If approved, I need authorization text we can include in the offer and permission to push DocuSign.

Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -04:00
Subject: RE: FW: FirmWave renewal — request for approval (business case)

Thanks for the clear case, Marissa. I approve a constrained package to balance retention and margin discipline. Approved concession:

- Discount: up to 15% list for 12 months (not 20%)
- One-time credit: $30,000 applied at renewal
- SLA add-on: 2-hour P1 response for 12 months + quarterly reliability review; we will add a service surcharge if ad-hoc SE hours exceed plan
- Term: prefer 15 months instead of 12 (to spread impact) — approve extension to 15 months if customer signs within 7 business days of offer

Conditions:
- Finance (Naomi), please confirm TCV/ARR impact and approve the accounting treatment of the credit.
- Legal to confirm the SLA language (I want liability caps preserved).
- Offer must include: customer commitment to quarterly review and an onboarding checklist for the SLA.

Marissa/Aditya — include the above text verbatim in the offer. Once Naomi confirms finance sign-off, proceed to DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/12345ABCD

Vivek Kulkarni
VP Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Eliza Morgan <eliza@firmwave.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, contracts@firmwave.com
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2026 20:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Final offer & next steps — FirmWave renewal (FW-2026-042)

Eliza — thank you for the patience. Leadership has approved a limited package to keep FirmWave on the platform. Below is the agreed offer (authorized by Redwood leadership):

Offer (authorized):
- One-time credit: $30,000 applied at renewal (line item: operational credit)
- Discount: 15% off list for the initial 12 months of the renewal term
- Term: 15 months (starts at signing) — this was approved as a compromise to spread ARR impact
- SLA add-on: 2-hour P1 response, quarterly reliability review for duration of term; escalation path documented in attached SOW

Conditions & next steps:
1) Finance will confirm accounting treatment; Naomi is on copy.
2) Legal will finalize SLA language and liability caps.
3) Please review the attached SOW (SOW-FirmWave-20261015.pdf) and the DocuSign link: https://docusign.example.com/12345ABCD
4) If agreed, please sign within 7 business days so we can preserve the 15-month term approval.

I’ve attached the revised offer and SOW to this message. If you want a short call to walk through the SLA wording and the quarterly review cadence, I’m available early next week.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping FirmWave as a strategic partner.

Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: RW-RevOffer-v3.pdf, SOW-FirmWave-20261015.pdf
